name: HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee Notice of Public Hearing Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE NO. N2M21-33

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
NOTICE NO. N2M21-33

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that on April 6, 2021 at 7:00 PM, or as soon thereafter as the matter
may be heard, HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY (HCDA)
COMMITTEE will hold a public hearing on the City of Alhambra’s proposed 2021-2022 Annual Action
Plan, to receive comment pursuant to and in compliance with the Federal Department of Housing and
Urban Development (HUD) pre-submission requirements. PLEASE NOTE: Consistent with Executive
Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 form the Executive Department of the State of California and the
County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer At Home Order, the HCDA Committee
meeting will not be physically open to the public, although the public may participate via teleconference
or video, and Committee Members may choose to participate via teleconference or video rather than in
person. Details regarding how to listen to and participate in the meeting will be outlined in the agenda
posted for the April 6, 2021 meeting on the city’s website: www.cityofalhambra.org.
The HCDA Committee will be providing an overview of the programs the City will continue to offer
throughout the next fiscal year. These programs include:
  • Fair Housing  • CDBG Administration
  • Housing Rehabilitation  • HOME Administration
  • Code Enforcement  • Community Housing Development
  • Public Services  Organizations (CHDO)
  • Public Facilities & Capital Improvements  • Home Buyer Program

All members of the community are invited to attend via teleconference or video. The City of Alhambra
welcomes the participation of Alhambra citizens in the development of the 2021-2022 Annual Action
Plan. This plan has been prepared in advance of the City receiving its final funding allocation from
HUD, the budget figures will be adjusted upon receipt of our allocation.
Any person wishing to be heard on this matter is invited to attend this public hearing and speak to the
HCDA Committee at the time and place stated. Pursuant to California Public Resources Code Section
2117, no action or proceeding may be brought in court unless that alleged grounds for noncompliance
with the California Environmental Quality Act were presented to the HCDA Committee orally or in
writing by any person, and no person shall maintain an action or proceeding unless that person objected
to the approval of the Project orally or in writing to the HCDA Committee.

JESSICA BINNQUIST, CITY MANAGER
City of Alhambra
111 S. First Street
Alhambra, CA 91801

Notice No. N2M21-33
March 18, 2021
